fomod.Name: Skyrim SE Parallax and Diffuse Texture Generator
fomod.Author: JosephsDeadish
fomod.Description: A standalone Windows tool that generates parallax, normal, glow, environment mask, and complex material textures for Skyrim Special Edition from DDS, PNG, TGA, or BMP source textures. v0.6 adds the NIF Editor — patch BSLightingShaderProperty flags and texture slots in Skyrim SE mesh files so any mod can gain parallax, ENB complex-material, and environment-mapping support without requiring the author to have set it up. Includes FoMod packaging for MO2/Vortex and detects mod-manager context on launch so loaded mod texture and mesh folders are pre-populated in the UI.
